text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-queue-depth" severity=high -> queue depth crossing critical threshold in prod (us-west-2). PD ref: https://pagerduty.example/INC-98123 :rotating_light:

devon (oncall): acked @PagerDuty. I'm looking at autoscaler + queue metrics now. tagging @maria @sam for infra help.

maria: seeing spike in 5xx and timeouts for hosted inference. frontend errors: 504s up ~3x. live queue depth: 9.2k, qcap=10k, steady rising. Latency p95 ~1.8s -> 6.2s.

devon (oncall): running quick checks, HPA shows desired replicas not increasing:
```
kubectl get hpa inference-hotpath -n prod
NAME                 REFERENCE                TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
inference-hotpath    Deployment/inference     95%/80%     8         100       8          4h

kubectl describe hpa inference-hotpath -n prod
Events:
  Normal  SuccessfulRescale  10s  horizontal-pod-autoscaler  New size: 8; reason: failed to get metrics from external metrics API
```

devon (oncall): looks like external metric (queue-depth) failing -> HPA silent. I suspect metric pipeline or provider quota.

sam: checking cloud quota for node autoscaler. seeing repeated 429/QuotaExceeded on provider side for scale requests in us-west-2. Provider returned: "insufficient quota for requested resource" around the same timestamps.

ops-bot: manual mitigation action: scaling deployment to 30 replicas (was 8) to immediately reduce queue pressure. `kubectl scale deploy/inference-hotpath --replicas=30 -n prod` executed.

maria: routing change suggestion: shift some traffic to fallback-model-1 (smaller, quantized variant) to reduce per-request GPU time. canary weight 30%?

devon (oncall): applied routing override: set weight fallback-model-1=30% via traffic-router.impact. Routing logs show traffic redirected.

irene (secondary): I'm taking over the thread for the escalation window, pulling metrics and logs. thanks @devon for the scale + routing. I'll coordinate with cloud support for quota bump.

sam: opened support ticket with provider (TKT-5521) to raise node quota and prioritize autoscale calls. Also triggered emergency node pool increase (request in progress).

maria: after scale+routing, queue depth trending down -> 9.2k -> 6.7k -> 2.1k in ~8 minutes. 5xx reduced to baseline.

devon (oncall): confirming: PD auto-escalation fired once, but we had ack. Marking timeline in incident. Current status: service degraded but accepting traffic; fallback in place.

irene (secondary): plan for next 2 hrs: monitor autoscaler metrics, ensure external metrics API healthy, confirm provider quota increase. If provider doesn't resolve, we'll keep routing fallback and keep manual node pool increased.

devon (oncall): post-incident immediate actions: 1) add early alert at 60% queue depth (today threshold was 85%), 2) update HPA runbook to include fallback routing step and manual scale command, 3) add retry/backoff on external metrics client to avoid transient failures. Created PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/PR-1345

maria: customer impact note for status page: "Some hosted inference requests experienced elevated latency and intermittent 504s for ~20 minutes in us-west-2. We routed traffic to a lower-latency fallback while scaling capacity; issue now mitigated. Follow-up: adjusting autoscaler thresholds and working with provider on quota."

ops-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by devon (oncall) at 4076543226; escalated to irene at 4076543240; resolved condition cleared at 4076543550.

devon (oncall): marking this thread for postmortem. Handing off to @irene for the next watch. I'll add timeline notes to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:

irene (secondary): taking handoff. I'll run through runbook and schedule postmortem async. Thanks all for quick work, especially manual scale + routing.

ops-bot: closing note: temporary mitigations in place (manual replicas=30, routing fallback=30%). Follow-ups assigned: QUOTA-5521 (provider quota), RUNBOOK-89 (HPA runbook update), ALERT-207 (60% early queue alert).

devon (oncall): final note — root cause suspected: provider throttling/quota preventing node autoscaler from provisioning nodes quickly, causing external metrics to time out; HPA couldn't react. We'll validate in postmortem.

irene (secondary): last check: queue at 900, CPU stable, error rate normal. I will keep monitoring for another 30m then close PD.

ops-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved at 4076543550.
